caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a woman standing on a plain, beige background. She is wearing an ankle-length, dark green coat with a vertical row of buttons down the front and a flared skirt, which is lined at the bottom with pleated, dark blue fabric. The coat features white fur trim around the high collar, down the front edges, and at the cuffs. The woman's hands are visible, and she has a white fur muff with a small red detail held in front of her. Her hair is parted at the center and styled back, and her face is depicted with light skin, attentively drawn blue eyes, arched eyebrows, and pink lips and cheeks. One of her shoes is tan, and the other appears mostly hidden under the coat. The composition is centered on the figure, and there are no additional objects or background elements.
title: Doll
